column1: # qw-build (hw-qwen), 2026-10-15: LightOnOCR-3 in the app. The 21 pages of HW-PANEL-2026-10-15.tsv, each a one-page PDF of its JPEG (sips),
# through Tools/score-gate.swift (OCRModel.start(), the helper, JBIG2) built from this commit's Sources less two late changes (the text page's
# header wording, and model markup stripped from it; rerun with them: the same 20 text pages, every gate check clean), with -accurateMode YES -accurateHandReader
# lightonocr-3 -accurateEnabledReaders lightonocr-3 -modelMemoryGB 8 -handTextPage YES; the model from the lab's cache of the pinned revision,
# run by the app's runtime (mlx-vlm 0.7.4) and Resources/read-model.py. 22 documents (the 21 and a mixed file) in 8 min 30 s, 21 model readings.
# Scored exactly as HW-PANEL (score-bakeoff.py's tokens, a bag, [illegible] left out); the scorer reproduces HW-PANEL's lighton rows and HW-MEASURE's Vision rows exactly.
# text_page: page 2 is a 612 pt text page. missed_textpage/added: its reading against the truth; missed_vision/added: page 1's own layer (Vision's);
# missed_union: the two together, as Find sees the file; panel_missed: HW-PANEL's reading of the source JPEG.
# Handwritten (2,825 words), missed per 1,000 and added: text page 120, 350 (p048 had none: not judged handwritten); on the 18 with one, 99 against the panel's 96.
# Vision's layer 561, 1,189 (as HW-MEASURE). Union 81. Mixed (202 words): p031 has one (20, as the panel); p009 was not judged handwritten.
# p049: 88 added against the panel's 11, a model note appended to the reading ("Note: The handwritten text contains some unclear ...").
# Find, PDFKit findString over each file, HW-PLACE's 1,405 distinct truth words of 4+ letters: 1,238 found (align 922, Vision alone 585; image pages alone 585).
# mixed-3pages (p007, a printed page of "1954 - Why.pdf", p015): 5 pages, p007 image, its text page, the printed page, p015 image, its text page.
